blocks.text: The system uses Debian packages and declared signed external package sources. Computer Management → System & Recovery → Maintenance & Health → Packages & Firmware provides package-health and pending-upgrade views and deliberately authorized update actions.

These commands inspect local package metadata. The first may be stale until an authorized index refresh. They do not download updates. Review available space and backups before applying a large update.

Package source definitions and scoped keys live under /etc/apt/. Preserve conffiles and the selected release/pinning policy. If an update is interrupted, inspect package-health/log evidence before an administrator resumes repair.
Do not disable signature verification, add arbitrary package sources, delete package locks or reboot while package configuration is active. Help never contacts APT or installs dependencies.
